values.note: Electric sites $40 a night for non-residents of Wright County ($32 residents); tandem sites $61 ($51 residents). The $6 reservation fee is non-refundable.

fees.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/facilities/facility/details/Schroeder-County-Park-Campground-11 ('Electric campsite: $32 per night for Residents of Wright County, $40 per night for Non-Residents'; 'Tandem campsite: $51 ... $61 per night for Non-Residents'; 'A $6 reservation fee applies to all reservable campsites.') + campground PDF ('Reservation Fee $6.00 Non Refundable'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: Schroeder Campground Map and Information PDF (legend: 'Electric Site (30 amp)', 'Electric Site (50/30 amp)', 'Tandem Site (50/30 amp)', 'ADA Site (50/30 amp)') + county page ('50-unit overnight campground with electric hookups'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Electric sites in two loops, 30 or 50/30 amp, including tandem and ADA sites; five are same-day sites reserved by phone from 8 a.m.

sites.source: Schroeder Campground Map and Information PDF (sites 1-50; 'Five (5) sites are same day reservation sites. You must call the Park Office to reserve the site.'), read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/facilities/facility/details/Schroeder-County-Park-Campground-11 ('a sanitary dump station, and modern restrooms with showers'; feature 'Water') + PDF ('sanitary disposal station located in the campground'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Wright County's own reservation system; bookings for the season open in early March (8 a.m. for county residents, 10 a.m. for others). Five same-day sites are reserved by calling the park office after 8 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.wrightcountymn.gov/facilities/facility/details/Schroeder-County-Park-Campground-11 ('Camping is limited to a maximum of 7 consecutive nights'; 'Campsites open for reservation on Monday, March 2, 2026 for the 2026 season. 8 a.m. for Wright County Residents and 10 a.m. for all others.'; Campsites link to the WebTrac site) + Same-Day Site Reservations PDF, read 2026-11-11

note: Wright County park on the north-west shore of 837-acre Cedar Lake, 2 miles north-east of Annandale off CSAH 39; sand swimming beach, boat launch with dock, fishing pier, fish-cleaning house, playground, volleyball, a short hiking trail, and snacks at the park office. Residents of Wright County pay less. --Claude
summary: County page + campground PDF read: 50 electric sites (30 or 50/30 amp), $40 non-resident ($32 resident) + $6 reservation fee confirmed; 7-night max; season 2026 May 1-Oct 18 (was approximate Apr 20-Sep 30); showers, flush toilets, dump. Waterfront: the south row of the loops sits 30-40 m from Cedar Lake behind a road and broken trees - lakeview suggested (upgrade, reviewer's call). Pin OK. Phone none -> 320-274-8870.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront -> lakeview (suggested upgrade; reviewer's call). z19 imagery: the southern sites of the loops (an RV pad at ~45.28318,-94.06698, likely site 7, and another at ~45.28318,-94.06653, around 17-18 on the county map) sit 30-40 m north of the Cedar Lake shore, across the loop road and a strip of grass carrying the paved trail to the fishing pier, with tree clumps either side rather than a continuous band; the view opens down the pier trail. Not lakefront: no pad on open ground within ~50 m, and the day-use beach and pier lie between. The stored evidence ('shoreline treeline buffer') reads the clumps as a continuous screen; if the reviewer agrees with it, keep not waterfront.
Season: derived approximate 04-20 to 09-30 -> manual 05-01 to 10-18 (2026 dates posted by the county); old 'Approximate' note cleared.
Hookups: electric 50 added (50/30-amp sites on the map legend); water and sewer at sites not mentioned anywhere, left unknown.
Booking: max stay 7 nights. Platform 'operator' (Wright County's Vermont Systems WebTrac reservation site, no listed platform value fits).
Pin 45.28406,-94.06643 is on Ireland Ave NW at the campground's east side, ~60-100 m from the nearest loops: OK.
Phone: none stored -> 320-274-8870 (Schroeder Park Office; reservations by phone at this number). Website confirmed.
Cancellation: $15 per site 14+ days out, $20 at 7-13 days, $25 at 1-6 days; no-show forfeits (PDF). Not a criteria issue.
